name: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd
title: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd - 543657 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell 34% to INR66.4 crore on salt pricing down ~10% and logistics shock; bromine production back to ~55 tpd but management gave no numeric guidance and FY27 volume goal is ~25,000 t.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization for the quarter still remained at around 45%, and we continue to focus on driving that up.

capex.peers_comment: Management said competitors are adding salt capacity in Australia and parts of the Middle East.
capex.quote: with increasing capacity in multiple regions and some more being added in FY '26 in Australia and some parts of the Middle East.

triggers.label: Majority of bromine LTCs repriced up
triggers.quote: the majority of our bromine contracts stand renegotiated upwards

triggers.label: Bromine back to ~55 tpd
triggers.quote: we are roughly getting back to that range right now in terms of daily production

triggers.label: Salt capacity additions in Australia, Middle East
triggers.quote: some more being added in FY '26 in Australia and some parts of the Middle East

triggers.label: Salt shipments 4.5 mt target missed (4.2 mt)
triggers.quote: We had earlier shared that we estimated to meet around 4.5 million tons of shipments during the year

triggers.label: Oren INR150 cr revenue path delayed
triggers.quote: The remaining part of the business, which was around half that INR150 crores

guidance.value: 15%-20% a year; 25,000 t next, then 40,000 t over time
guidance.quote: we are expecting or hoping to be able to grow 15 %-20% a year in terms of bromine production
we do expect the salt business will continue to grow at 10% to 12%

guidance.value: Substructure work from July 2026; 27-30 months to completion
guidance.quote: Our target is to start the substructure work from July.

guidance.metric: Oren / Idealis two of three plants operating
guidance.value: At least two of three plants at reasonable volume in H2 FY27
guidance.quote: we expect that all -- at least two out of the three plants will be in operations at reasonable volume in the second half of the year

prior_guidance_check.metric: Salt shipments of 4.5 million tons in FY26
prior_guidance_check.quote: We had earlier shared that we estimated to meet around 4.5 million tons of shipments during the year, which has largely been impacted
we had given a guidance of INR150 crores was basically divided across three products

red_flags.label: Salt finished inventory build; INR13 cr stock increase in COGS
red_flags.quote: salt, finished salt inventory increased during the quarter, and that is a substantial part of what you will see there as an increase in inventory cost

red_flags.label: Management refused to give breakeven or forward metrics
red_flags.quote: No Avnish, I don't make -- we don't make forward-looking statements.

red_flags.label: Oren plant held up by Gujarat approvals / NCLT interpretation
red_flags.quote: the Gujarat government has interpret some of the NCLT provisions or orders in a slightly different way

evasions.topic: Forward guidance on subsidiary breakeven and EBITDA
Bromine pricing range for next year
evasions.quote: I will avoid giving the range as well
We don't make a specific view like that.
